Aluminium has a specific heat capacity of 900J/(kg°C).
The internal energy of a 2.0kg block of aluminium increases by 13500J.
By how much does the temperature of the block increase?
0.067°C
0.13°C
7.5°C
15°C
A
B
C
D
subject: Physics
